thesis: CDNA is extended after a roughly 71% 63-day run and a gap to the 52-week high, with growth decelerating both YoY and sequentially while valuation is rich (forward P/E about 52, P/S 8.6). Reward/risk is only about 1.3 into a 90.87 target, with a structural stop 14% below the close and ATR of 6.6%, so a normal swing can hit the stop. The regime is neutral with tech and growth under pressure from a 5.05% 10-year yield, and high-beta names tend to be sold first in that rotation. An officer Form 144 sale after the run, fading post-gap volume, and the Zacks #1 upgrade (a crowded, backward-looking signal) all argue for waiting for a pullback to the entry zone rather than buying now.
